text:
mira: Heads-up — since the kernel/6.1.12 push to eu-west2 GPU pools we've seen a spike in GPU allocation failures and NCCL handshake timeouts. Affected jobs are hitting autoscaler churn and retry cost is climbing.

deploy-bot: [deploy] kernel/6.1.12 rolled to eu-west2-gpu-pool (25 nodes) by aditya at 2026-03-18T08:20:00Z

aditya: Confirming. We rolled a staged batch at 08:20. Canary looked fine (2 nodes) but after the full batch we started getting alerts.

mira: Sample symptoms: pods stuck in ContainerCreating, kubelet logs showing module probe failures, and ML jobs reporting NCCL WARN handshake timeouts. Also seeing NVRM Xid errors on some hosts.

kai: Can you paste the dmesg and a short log? I want to see the exact probe error.

mira: Pasting a short snippet from one affected host: 

```
[ 3456.123456] nvidia: loading out-of-tree module taints kernel.
[ 3456.124001] nvidia: probe of nvidia0 failed with error -22
[ 3456.125678] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 79, PID: 1982, GPU: 0, Channel: 0000
[ 3456.126900] kernel: BUG: unable to handle kernel NULL pointer dereference at 0000000000000008
```

mira: And the ML job side: 

```
[2026-03-18T08:35:12Z] NCCL WARN Call to rank 2 timed out, handshake failed
[2026-03-18T08:35:15Z] NCCL INFO Retrying connect
```

aditya: Looks like driver + kernel ABI mismatch. We rebuilt dkms on one node to test: `sudo dkms autoinstall` then `modprobe nvidia`. On the rebuild node the modules load but I still see intermittent NCCL timeouts under load.

kai: Which driver version? Which CUDA?

mira: Driver 525.60.13, CUDA 11.8 runtime images. We haven't changed container images in the rollout.

sre-oncall: Operational impact: autoscaler sees pods pending -> schedules more nodes -> new nodes hit same issue -> repeats. We're burning preemptibles and spinning up more reserved pools, cost estimate +18% this window. Users reporting failed experiments too.

aditya: Immediate mitigations we put in flight: 
- pinned new nodepools to kernel 5.15 (cluster autoscaler will prefer old pools)
- added a kubernetes PodDisruptionBudget tweak to reduce churn for long-running training jobs
- bumped retry backoff in our job-controller so it doesn't aggressively reschedule on host-level failures

mira: How do we pin? We labeled the old nodes with `kernel=5.15-stable` and created a nodeSelector on our critical pools so they don't get evicted. That bought some time.

kai: We should also stop further kernel rollouts until we repro in the lab. I'll spin up a small 6.1 test pool with identical drivers and run a stress repro.

aditya: We're opening a formal incident ticket and vendor escalation to NVIDIA — the pattern looks like a subtle API/ABI change in 6.1 that breaks some driver paths under heavy PCI traffic. Ticket #INC-6821.

mira: Next steps list: 
1) kai: reproduce in isolated lab and collect `modinfo`, `dmesg`, `nvidia-smi -q`, and perf traces — ETA 2h
2) aditya: freeze kernel rollouts in all other regions until lab repro confirmed — done
3) sre-oncall: apply autoscaler throttles and increase scheduling cooldowns — in progress
4) mira: coordinate cost impact and notify customers with long-running jobs (SOC/CS ping) — in progress

sre-oncall: Quick commands useful for everyone when debugging: 
```
journalctl -u kubelet -n 200 --no-pager
dmesg | grep -i nvidia -n
modinfo nvidia | sed -n '1,40p'
nvidia-smi -q > /tmp/gpu-q.txt
```

aditya: Also check for mismatched `/lib/modules/$(uname -r)/updates/dkms` contents. I've seen stale .ko files get picked up after apt upgrade.

mira: FYI we saw one host where `lsmod` showed both `nvidia` and `nvidia_drm` but modinfo showed an ABI mismatch. Rebuilding kernel modules via DKMS fixed that host temporarily.

kai: If we can't get a clean repro, plan B is an emergency rollback of the kernel to 5.15 across eu-west2. That will be disruptive but preferable to continued job failures. We should prepare communication and a migration window.

mira: Agreed. Also logging this into the model-serving team channel since batch jobs are affected too.

ops-bot: @here Incident INC-6821 created. Severity: P2. SLA owner: aditya. Timeline updated.

aditya: I'll take vendor escalation and file a bisect plan for the kernel tree. If anyone has time, please grab a node and repro — I put a checklist in the ticket.

mira: Thanks all — keep updates in this thread. If cost spikes further I'll escalate to finance for a temporary budget increase for compute. :eyes:

kai: I'll post repro logs in ~1.5h. If we confirm kernel-6.1 regressions we coordinate rollback and a postmortem.

sre-oncall: Noted. Also enabling extra monitoring for NCCL handshake errors and NVRM Xid counts across regions so we can watch for cross-region spread.

mira: End of thread for now.
